Where to catch Rhydon

Rhydon cannot be caught in the wild in FireRed/LeafGreen. You only get it through evolution: Rhyhorn evolves into Rhydon starting at level 42.

Other games? Find every location per route and version in the interactive maps.

Rhyhorn evolves into Rhydon starting at level 42..

Not in the wild. Rhydon cannot be caught in the wild in FireRed/LeafGreen. You only get it through evolution: Rhyhorn evolves into Rhydon starting at level 42.

Our take: Yes, late. Rhydon has huge Attack and Defense but 4× weaknesses to Water and Grass. Unplayable against the wrong teams, otherwise a wall with bite.
